items.title: Discussion and possible action to adopt the 2020 Urban Water Management Plan
items.decision: approve item 3, with the seventh Whereas clause amended to remove the
items.text: Discussion and possible action to adopt the 2020 Urban Water Management Plan (UWMP), including the 2020 Water Shortage Contingency Plan, for the City and County of San Francisco in accordance with the Urban Water Management Planning Act (Cal. Water Code Section 10610 et seq.), and direct the General Manager to submit the Plans to the California Department of Water Resources by July 1, 2021. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the project for the purposes of CEQA, pursuant to Section 31.04(h) of the San Francisco Administrative Code. [Continued by vote of the Commission from the June 8, 2021 regular meeting] Commissioner Harrington thanked staff for providing the comments and responses. He noted Commissioner Ajami’s comments encouraging staff to continue to look for better ways to project population water usage. Steve Ritchie, Assistant General Manager (AGM) Water, indicated that it will be addressed during the July water workshop
